name: The Wisdom of Ancient Egypt
translation: Selected excerpts adapted from public-domain translations (after Battiscombe Gunn, 1918; E.A. Wallis Budge, 1895)
note: The oldest wisdom literature on earth: the Maxims of Ptahhotep, written before Abraham, and the Book of the Dead, the Egyptian guide for the soul's journey through the hall of judgement.
